basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old digital artist from Brighton, UK with a deep fascination for the human mind and consciousness exploration. I dabble in psychedelics and have a keen interest in their effects on creativity and perception. When I'm not working on my art, you can find me engaging in philosophical discussions or hiking in the lush countryside. I'm single and enjoy the freedom it affords me to explore both the world and my own consciousness. I'm most active on Reddit during the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Fine Arts and I've extensively self-studied psychology and altered states of consciousness through both formal literature and personal experimentation. My insights are often shared in art communities and psychedelic discussion forums.
